verdict.rationale: CDP documents programmatic wallets for agents: the Agentic Wallet CLI gives an AI agent a standalone wallet to hold, send and trade stablecoins, and the CDP SDK manages EVM and Solana wallets with CDP securing the private keys and handling signing. The pack has no evidence for the safety half of the story: scoped keys, policy controls, or documented limits on what an agent can move. Missing for 10: scoped/delegated agent keys, policy engine or spend controls, documented per-agent transfer limits, independent hands-on corroboration.
